about: Allowed hits of Tools/leak_check.py's generic hard classes (path.drive, path.profile, email): an entry allows a hit when the path matches the glob (the export manifest's glob rules), the class matches (when given) and the regex is found in the hit's text (the path-like run or the address). Drive letters are written as a class ([C]:) so the patterns do not match themselves. Private tokens are never allow-listed here: this file is committed; narrow the local pattern instead. 'policy_data' lists the files of the release policy's data allow-list: exported files that keep the card's uncensor data as inert data (decoder, import, document section, field schema, plugin sections) and the data tests; policy.uncensor does not look at them.

allow.reason: synthetic input of the bridge's path rule test (an absolute path is refused)
synthetic absolute paths the save / load commands must refuse (io_denied)
a synthetic absolute path chara.save must refuse (io_denied)
synthetic install and zipmod paths of the redirect tests (no file is read)
a synthetic full path of the scene-model test kit
synthetic coordinate-card paths of the per-sex folder rule test
the example value of hs2Root (a neutral placeholder users replace)
the standard install folders of Microsoft Edge (the browser the check may start); not machine data
Windows' standard Program Files folder as the fallback when the ProgramFiles variable is missing; not machine data

policy_data.reason: the card decoder of the plugin's data (kept inert, round-trips)
the import of the plugin data into body.uncensor (data)
the document section body.uncensor (frozen format v1)
the field schema rows of body.uncensor (data)
the plugin sections built from the documents (data)
data test: the import of every card
